title: World Heroes
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, 9 characters.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D), read at every frame ("fast") for the moves recognised at the stick (1.39); read the other way round if up and down show together

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits

_p1_dir.note: the side player 1's fighter faces (FBNeo training mode by peon2 and contributors): a motion of the stick reads the other way round when the fighter faces left (1.39). What the byte holds when a round starts is learnt as facing right; not seen in a recorded game yet

_p2_dir.note: the side player 2's fighter faces (FBNeo training mode by peon2 and contributors): a motion of the stick reads the other way round when the fighter faces left (1.39). What the byte holds when a round starts is learnt as facing left; not seen in a recorded game yet

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x68; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB4 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x68; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB4 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second, 31 frames to one count: it steps with the frames between two snapshots and wraps as the timer counts (the robot's two recorded games, 28 rounds). Held at 30 while the round is announced, its first move away gives FIGHT ! as the timer starts, it waited for the timer's first count (1.39)

_fight_cue.note: the game's own call of the fight: held at 6 while ROUND n shows, it moves 32 frames before the timer starts, as FIGHT! is on the screen (the filmed starts of its rounds, 33 of 35 rounds of three recorded games). Its first move away from 6 gives FIGHT ! with the game's own, the timer's start came as that text left the screen (1.39)

score_p2.note: player 2, to find with learn.bat (two-player game, score2=...)

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Janne, 1 Hanzou, 2 Dragon, 3 Muscle Power, 4 J. Carn, 5 Rasputin, 6 Brocken, 7 Fuuma, 8 Geegus, 9 Janne (death match), 10 Hanzou (death match), 11 Dragon (death match), 12 Muscle Power (death match), 13 J. Carn (death match), 14 Rasputin (death match), 15 Brocken (death match), 16 Fuuma (death match), 17 Geegus (death match), 18 1st bonus stage, 19 2nd bonus stage. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

hd.note: HD screen theme and place for each backdrop value (index = value), see the wiki, HD Marquee page. The MAME cheat database names each backdrop after its fighter, 0 to 8 in the normal mode, 9 to 17 in the death match mode, 18 and 19 the bonus stages; themes and places set from the screenshots of the robot's recording of 2026-11-16: 0 a circus (Janne), 1 a red temple gate (Hanzou), 2 a Chinese temple (Dragon), 4 a camp in the steppe at sunset (J. Carn), 6 a factory (Brocken), 8 a space station (Geegus), 10 and 11 rings of the death match mode, 18 and 19 the Chinese temple again. 3 was not met; 5 and 7 are not clear on the screenshots and keep the theme they had The values above the last stage are read between the fights: the arena, no place named, so that they do not come round onto a stage

specials.note: special moves and supers of each fighter, shown under a human player's name (1.38): from the command list of MAME (command.dat 0.273, Fabricio Coroquer and AntoPISA), made by tools/command_dat.py
